description: This file provides CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) operations and core logic for managing users, games, game states, and related functionalities in a Tic-Tac-Toe backend. It includes importing modules for database interaction, password hashing, JWT token creation, and game logic such as move validation, winner detection, and game over conditions.

methods.name: Optional[models.User] create_user(db: Session, username: str, password: str)
methods.description: Creates a new user with a hashed password; returns the user object if successful or None if username exists.

methods.name: bool verify_password(plain_password: str, hashed_password: str)
methods.description: Verifies a plain password against its hashed version.

methods.name: Optional[models.User] authenticate_user(db: Session, username: str, password: str)
methods.description: Authenticates a user by username and password, returning the user object if valid.

methods.name: str create_access_token(*, data: dict, expires_delta: timedelta = None)
methods.description: Generates a JWT access token encoding provided data with an optional expiration.

methods.name: Optional[models.User] get_user(db: Session, user_id: int)
methods.description: Fetches a user by their unique ID.

methods.name: Optional[models.User] get_user_by_username(db: Session, username: str)
methods.description: Fetches a user by their username.

methods.name: List[models.User] list_users(db: Session, skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100)
models.Game create_game(db: Session, player_x_id: Optional[int], player_o_id: Optional[int] = None)
methods.description: Creates a new Tic-Tac-Toe game, optionally with specified players, and initializes game state.

methods.name: Optional[models.Game] get_game(db: Session, game_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a game by its ID, including its current state.

methods.name: List[models.Game] list_games(db: Session, skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100)
methods.description: Lists all games with optional pagination.

methods.name: Optional[models.Game] join_game(db: Session, game_id: int, user_id: int)
methods.description: Allows a user to join a game as player O if the slot is free.

methods.name: Optional[models.GameState] get_game_state(db: Session, game_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves the current state (board, turn) of a specific game.

methods.name: Tuple[Optional[models.Game],Optional[models.GameState],str] make_move(db: Session, game_id: int, user_id: int, position: int)
methods.description: Processes a move for a given game and user, updating the game state, checking for win/draw conditions, and returning status messages.

methods.name: List[models.Game] get_user_games(db: Session, user_id: int)
methods.description: Returns a list of games that a user participated in, ordered by creation date.
